title: Embedded Systems Lab — AVR Firmware and Deterministic Simulation
problem: Build firmware with a real microcontroller target toolchain and prove deterministic timing/state-machine behavior in simulation without upgrading simulated evidence into a physical-hardware claim.
constraints: Host simulation proves controller logic but is not physical board operation.
No electrical or instrumentation claim without hardware measurement.
demonstrated_capability: interrupt-driven button sampling and LED output
host deterministic simulation of switch bounce and repeated presses

measured_result.simulation_result: bounce suppressed; two stable presses produced two toggles

external_witness.claim: embedded-systems-lab workflow run 1 passed AVR target build, HEX generation, deterministic debounce simulation, firmware size inspection, target image inspection, and artifact upload

limits: No circuit design or PCB design witness.
